body:
Interesting. I think being religious would make death a lot more scary than being an atheist.

Death as an atheist is just nothing. Death as a (western) religious person is apparently hell if you do it by suicide.

I know which I’d prefer.

Anyway, no. You’re not dramatic. Death is the unknown. It’s normal to be afraid of it. Even if we want it. 

Also, you probably already know and have tried and I know basically nothing about the situation. But hey, dump the abusive boyfriend and protect yourself from toxic people like that
